name: Arts Camp @ RoCA
description_short: Visual and performing arts day camp at the Rockland Center for the Arts in West Nyack, in air conditioned studios and a 5 acre sculpture park, for ages 5 to 14 grouped by grade. Campers do ceramics, painting, theater, dance, music and yoga, swim daily in the pool, and stage a musical at the end of each two week session.

fees.name: Early drop off or late pick up
fees.note: Per child; early drop off 8:30 to 9:30 am, late pick up 4 to 5 pm

notes: Two week sessions; musical theater is the Monday and Friday program. Children bring lunch; RoCA gives an afternoon ice cream or ice pop. Parents drive campers. 5:1 camper to counselor ratio for ages 5 to 9 and 7:1 for ages 10 to 14. 2027 tuition is not posted yet; the tuition page still shows the 2026 rates ($910 for a 3 day and $1,350 for a 5 day two week session, including a RoCA family membership), so they are left out. 2027 open houses March 6, April 10 and May 8.
